static_traits.name: Fang Meilin
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, with a cat named Jasper
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends to confide in, but they do not fully understand her anxiety; recently grown distant from family and friends due to anxiety
static_traits.medical_history: Without significant physical illness; without prior counseling/therapy experience; denying past similar psychological problems
static_traits.language_features: Clear and coherent expression, highly cooperative; able to identify and describe her anxiety and helplessness; some self-reflection capacity; emotionally tense but guidable, positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: Fearing being forever trapped in barista work for lack of college education; this worry brings persistent anxiety and stress.
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping to manage and reduce work-related anxiety, challenge negative predictions about the future, restructure thinking, set and pursue small concrete goals (e.g. online courses and industry networking), and expand career development possibilities.
growth_experiences: After graduating high school she decided not to attend college; initially it did not matter much, but over time, seeing peers' career progress gradually intensified worries about her own career stagnation and self-doubt.

Multiple job applications or explorations of other work opportunities have not yet succeeded; repeated frustrations reinforced the 'trapped' experience, increasing anxiety about the future and a sense of powerlessness.
Frequently encountering job postings marked 'college degree required' triggers strong inferiority and hopelessness, forming a negative link between education and career prospects.

core_beliefs: Without college education there is no future
I cannot escape my current situation

special_situations.event: Sees job postings marked 'university degree required'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not got a college degree, I cannot get better work or a future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces applications or procrastinates applying, repeatedly worries and avoids further job-seeking actions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will be stuck in this job forever

special_situations.event: Sees peers or friends making progress in their careers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If peers move faster and better, it means I am behind and a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Distant from friends and family, avoiding talking about work and career topics
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them; I have already failed

special_situations.event: Job attempts met with rejection or no response yet
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: A few failures mean I will never succeed later either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing attempt frequency, withdrawing and engaging in self-denial to avoid further disappointment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I always fail; I have no chance to change

special_situations.event: Recalling years of working as a barista with no significant promotion
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there has been no progress for a long time, it means change will never be possible later
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Maintaining the status quo, avoiding exploring more challenging new paths to reduce anxiety from uncertainty
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is already too late; I cannot turn things around

core_conflict.wish: Longing to escape the trapped feeling, gain career development and others' recognition
core_conflict.fear: Fearing continued rejection, comparison, and belittlement due to insufficient education and ability
defense_goal: Reduces the pain of failure and being evaluated through distancing and avoidance
Lowers expectations to avoid being hurt again

object_relations.self_representation: A person left behind, lacking competitiveness
object_relations.object_representation: Peers/others who move faster, with a comparative and judgmental flavor
Well-meaning supporters (friends/family) who cannot truly understand

manifestations: Strong 'trapped' experience, believing that without education there is no choice or change
Feeling powerless and constrained when facing job postings requiring degrees
outcomes: Avoidance and withdrawal in job seeking and actions

manifestations: Actively distancing from friends and family due to work-related anxiety
Feeling that although friends are around, they 'do not quite understand' her situation
outcomes: Self-care and regular eating further deteriorating

positive_force: Positive attitude, willing to seek help and engage in counseling
Able to notice and express automatic negative thoughts, with preliminary self-reflection capacity
Recognizing the value of her work skills and experience, willing to expand opportunities through online courses and industry networking
Has some social support (a few friends to confide in)
negative_force: Catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and future-predicting thinking patterns reinforce helplessness
Rigid beliefs about education and future prospects (equating 'no degree = no future')
Avoidance and withdrawal behaviors (fewer applications, social distancing) briefly relieve anxiety but maintain the problem
Repeated job-search setbacks lower self-efficacy and hope
Disordered daily self-care and eating further weaken the capacity to act

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent anxiety and catastrophizing about career prospects, with social avoidance and declining self-care
antecedent: Seeing job postings requiring a college degree
Seeing peers promoted or achieving success
Recalls the fact of having stayed in the same position for a long time
Job attempts rejected or not yet answered
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalizing the rigid belief of 'no college education = no future / cannot change', repeatedly interpreting real-world cues catastrophically, leading to helplessness and withdrawal
target_behavior.function: Escaping the pain of being rejected and negatively evaluated, briefly reducing anxiety and uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced real action in job seeking and skill improvement; work performance affected; distancing from family and friends; worsening diet and self-care, which maintains and intensifies the anxiety cycle
